dev variant u1 at 3150, preview, draft: first film variant with the medium light; reads as cloud; every cell too bright; line (i) 27.548
lab study try5 (not the film's shader): the same height field under a surface light (reads as rock) and as a medium lit through itself (reads as cumulus)

t9 3150 preview draft, no solve: billows that swell by a law of the film's time, curds for the balls. Reads as a mountain range, worse than t8; lower left darker than approved by shade alone (11 and 9 against 17 and 27). Line (i) 18.756. Not a state
t8 3150 preview draft, no solve: two step warp, fibres, smaller cumulus. Reads as folded clay; storm less clear. Line (i) 16.870, bands green (0.86 0.85 0.82 0.85). Not a state
t7 3150 preview draft, no solve: soft light and light passing thin crests added. Reads as satin sand with rock outcrops, not cloud. Line (i) 18.284. Not a state

3150, variant t6 in the second tree (not committed), draft, one sample: silk and cumulus by the new height law. It reads as dunes and dark rock, not as cloud. Line (i) 22.572. Dropped as a look; its laws are kept for the next variant with soft light.
Lab sheet, not the film's shader: billow noise as a height field, lit from the film's side. A form study for the silk between the tops.

State s, frame 3150 at one sample, lens 64 (left) and 50 (right), same eye point and aim. Lines on the ground fit a pinhole within 2.5 and 2.9 px rms of a 1920 frame; the lens is not a fisheye. Lens 40 is drawing

Design aid, not the film: four height laws drawn by a small offline tool against the same Sun (33.3 degrees, ahead left). Upper left is state s (pimples on a plain), upper right is t5 (reads as rock). Neither is cloud yet

State s, series at 60 a second, six neighbours enlarged 4 times near the storm rim: at draft (one sample a pixel) the edges crawl in steps. Mean second difference in time 1.75 levels, 3.3 percent of pixels over 8. Not yet shown at final tier

Dev tree, variant t2 at 3150, draft, 960 px (tall tops, fill by the open sky, matter floor 0.03, no solve). Darkness by cast shade works and edges stand 0.12 units before their ground, but it reads as rock and the low band is 25.3 (state s 9.27)

Dev tree, variant t4 at 3150, draft, 960 px (round towers 0.36 units wide, fill by the open sky, matter floor 0.03, no solve). Not film grade: reads as boulders, not cloud; the ceiling flattens the fine billows. Kept only as a step
